entries.ac8e81132d83ce64: This is a single segment providing “Laxus,” a subscription-based sharing service for branded bags. Members can use branded bags for a flat monthly fee, with free exchange and unlimited use. It also offers “Kaechau Laxus,” which lets members buy bags they are renting, and sells bags in the bag resale market. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,280 million, and the number of contracts as of March 31, 2026 (including double plans) was 19,254.

entries.c1bf5c09235396fc: It has the discernment developed through purchasing more than 40,000 bags from 60 brands, and procurement channels in Japan’s secondary distribution market. It has built in-house its maintenance technology for restoring damaged bags to a lendable condition, its free-location inventory management system and its original membership screening system, and it has a membership base in which members who have used the service for more than 12 months make up 62% of all members.
entries.c778a340cdc486da: The company states that, under its management philosophy of “bringing smiles to the world,” it aims to realize “a world in which the value of goods circulates and their lifetime value is maximized.” Under its medium-term management strategy, the company aims to maximize lifetime revenue from branded bags by leveraging its core model and held assets and to build a circular platform for valuable goods, and it cites as challenges the full-scale rollout of the new smart-keep service “Lax-mochi,” horizontal expansion of sharing into products other than bags, and verification of new service businesses.
